notes: Smart VPN (Config Proxy): detects a dead VPN server even when Android still shows 'connected' (reads OpenVPN's own status) and switches to a working config automatically; checks the EXACT config that is connected; waits smartly for the VPN handshake instead of a fixed timer (no more good configs wrongly quarantined); never blames a config when the phone's own Wi-Fi/network is down; waits for a rebooting phone to finish booting; never breaks a tunnel OpenVPN is already reconnecting by itself; Switch Profile waits for a busy phone instead of skipping it; tasks only start when the VPN really carries traffic; fixed a crash when closing the Config Proxy window; far fewer warnings (only real problems are shown).
